command: podman run --rm -v "$LIGHTNING_WS":/ws -v "$BAG":/bag:ro -v "$OUT":/out -w /ws/src/lightning-lm "$IMAGE" bash -c 'source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source /ws/install/setup.bash && taskset -c 0-3 ./bin/run_lio_tum --input_bag /bag --config /out/config.yaml --output /out/eig-2_imu.tum --timing /out/timing.csv --log_dir /out' > "$OUT/run.log" 2>&1 && python3 systems/se3-lvio/tools/to_prism.py "$MISSION/comfort_offline/calib.json" "$OUT/eig-2_imu.tum" "$OUT/estimate.tum"

env.IMAGE: the system's container image (systems/systems.yaml; local tag in lvx.local.yaml)
env.PATH: the caller's PATH, after the machine's own tool folders (lvx.local.yaml `path`, e.g. a docker shim)
env.LIGHTNING_WS: the lightning-lm colcon workspace built by scripts/build_lightning.sh
env.BAG: the mission as a ROS 2 bag: <run_root>/derived/lightning-bags/<mission>
